title: Global Innovation Index 2026: world’s top innovation clusters
discussion_signal: WIPO’s announcement foregrounds the geography and concentration of innovation clusters, patents, science, and venture capital. The signal supports a capability-and-diffusion reading in which innovation is embedded in place-based ecosystems rather than evenly available technology.
linked_research_question: How do concentrated innovation ecosystems shape diffusion, inequality, and the capacity of other places to participate?
limits: No cluster-level data or causal analysis is included in the indexed text
LinkedIn engagement is not a representative innovation debate
